name: Coral Magazine
description: Editorial/jurnal uslubi: iliq coral va teal ranglar, katta ta'sirli sarlavhalar, kreativ asimmetrik matn bloklari. Lifestyle, marketing va ijodiy taqdimotlar uchun.
prompt_guidance: Create engaging, magazine-style section titles that are factual yet captivating.
Each fact should tell a mini-story or reveal an interesting insight.
Keep facts slide-friendly in 1-2 lines and avoid dense paragraphs.
Use vivid but accurate language, balancing creativity with credibility.
Use tables sparingly, usually 0-1 per deck, for key comparisons only.
